rounds.text: Money Masters Leasing & Finance Ltd is trading at a steep discount to its intrinsic book value, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.48x based on a price of ₹ 0.72 against a book value of ₹ 1.50 [E2]. This valuation is significantly lower than the broader sector benchmark P/B of 1.36x [E7]. Furthermore, the company trades at a P/E of 13.6x, offering a favorable discount relative to the sector benchmark P/E of 20.12x [E6]. The firm's asset efficiency is practically on par with its peers, delivering a Return on Assets (ROA) of 1.77% compared to the sector benchmark of 1.79% [E8]. Adding to these fundamental values, recent momentum indicates that profit growth exceeds 1-year price growth by 30%, signaling that the company is starting to outperform expectations [E48]. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor sales growth of -6.91% over the past five years and a low return on equity of 3.49% over the last 3 years [E52, E54].
